|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Wes Janson, Rogue Veteran]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB7-02-Wes_Janson_Rogue_Veteran-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Virtual Block 7.3 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Wes Janson, Rogue Veteran]].
* '''Original''' ([[Wes Janson, Rogue Veteran]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011), which prints the first sentence as the pilot icon with “2.”: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per turn, may ▼ (or deploy from hand) Disruptor Pistol for free on Wes. May fire Disruptor Pistol for 1 Force. Power and forfeit +1 while with Hobbie or Wedge. If about to leave table, place cards on Wes in owner’s Used Pile.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 16) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Wes Janson, Rogue Veteran (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 December 2012) changed “Once per turn, may” to “Once per turn may”, “Disruptor Pistol for free” to “Disrupter Pistol for free” (typo as published), “forfeit +1 while with” to “Forfeit +1 when with” and “leave table, place cards on Wes” to “leave table place cards aboard Wes” (the card list writes the pilot icon as “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots.” and the ▼ icon as “\/”): “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Once per turn may ▼ (or deploy from hand) Disrupter Pistol for free on Wes. May fire Disruptor Pistol for 1 Force. Power and Forfeit +1 when with Hobbie or Wedge. If about to leave table place cards aboard Wes in owner's Used Pile.”.<ref name="cl-1273_30-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
